name: 方阵·剑·T2·鞋子
prompt:
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: the actual game character and simple sword supply the soft dark outline and two/three broad shade planes, NOT item silhouette or metal material.
Use case: precise-object redesign. Asset type: ONE transparent chibi RPG equipment PNG, gear-omega-sword-t2-boots.
This entire physical construction MUST differ visibly from regular steel/leather equipment. At 48px the outer silhouette must read as ANCIENT MATTE STONE BLOCKS and open square frame construction. It is not regular armour with cyan gemstones.
Subject for the sword-family prototype: a compact overlapping pair of BLOCKY rune-stone greaves with FLAT SQUARE TOES, simple open squared ankle cuffs and thick low stone soles, pointing right. No rounded silver toe caps, no V-folded leather cuffs or belt buckles.
For other weapon families, preserve their functional identity and family silhouette (hammer broad squat, axe crescent, staff long upright fork, hidden three separated blades, wand short round bud) while rebuilding the physical body from STONE BLOCKS and open frames.
Series palette dominates: dark muted SAGE/SLATE rune-stone, muted cyan in small recessed details, tiny restrained bronze joints. No silver or blue-grey polished steel, no giant jewels, no glowing aura, no futuristic machine.
T2 DEVELOPED: substantially change the silhouette with TWO large structural layers: visibly wider forked guard/head support, fuller shoulder plates and reinforced collar, taller open helmet brow, larger layered boot cuffs; pendant/ring mounts are clearly larger and double-framed. Keep only one main core. Changes must be obvious at 48px, not engraved lines.
Style: soft warm charcoal/brown outline, chunky rounded object proportions, matte hand-drawn colour blocks, TWO or THREE large shading planes, warm restrained highlights. Keep details broad and legible. Match the new simple chibi items, not the skinny ornate old library.
Composition: one compact overlapping pair of boots pointing right, front shoe fully visible. Centred on a square transparent canvas, full object visible, longest visible extent roughly 78–82% of canvas, generous equal safety margin. Do not enlarge T3 beyond the common size.
At 32px the equipment part must read immediately; at 48px the family, series and stage must be recognisable by structure. Each icon depicts a coherent physical wearable or weapon, not a pasted symbol.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha; ONE isolated object (a pair only for boots). No background, floor, external cast shadow, frames, labels, text, numbers, rarity tags, characters, particles, glowing discs, tiny filigree or dense shiny rendering. Do not generate a sprite sheet or collage. The output is one production PNG.
The LAST reference is the completed BASIC T1 version of this exact equipment family and part. Preserve its broad drawing style and family palette, but DO NOT reuse its contour. Make the requested higher stage visibly different through the major outer guard/shoulder/crest/cuff/setting structures; it must not look like T1 with new engraving or extra gems.
Additional comparison: the SECOND-TO-LAST reference is basic T1, and the LAST reference is complete T3. Draw the unmistakeable INTERMEDIATE T2 structure: two substantial layers, with fuller guard/shoulder/crest/cuff/setting than T1 but visibly less extended and simpler than T3. Do not copy either endpoint.
normalization: alpha crop and proportional Lanczos inside 208px, centred on transparent 256px canvas
reviewNote: Small-size overview reveals too similar an outline to the adjacent stage. Rebuild the main shape instead of adding trim.
